items.title: H-E-B, Southwest, Dell lead Forbes' best Texas companies list
items.summary: H-E-B beat out Southwest, Dell and ExxonMobil to top Forbes’ new list of the best companies based in Texas. Tesla squeaked in at No. 25.

items.title: UBS assesses impact of nationwide ground stop on US airlines’ 4Q outlook
items.summary: Investing.com -- U.S. airlines face lower fourth-quarter capacity, higher operating costs, and pressure on earnings following a nationwide ground stop that disrupted flights for three days, according to UBS analysts Atul Maheswari and Thomas Wadewitz.

items.title: Should Investors Avoid Copa Holdings Despite Q3 Earnings Beat?
items.summary: We assess the investment worthiness of CPA stock post its third-quarter 2026 earnings release.

items.title: Southwest (LUV) Up 8.5% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Continue?
items.summary: Southwest (LUV) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.title: Boeing Is Down 37% From Its High, and Its Jet Unit Is in an “Overstaffed Position.” Is the Selling Overdone?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysBoeing just hit a fresh 52-week low, 37% below its January high, because its 737 production ramp keeps slipping and its cash targets keep moving to later years. A 5% cut to its jet workforce and lower October deliveries show the slower ramp is real, and it also matters for engine maker GE Aerospace and for Southwest Airlines, which flies only 737s.

items.title: One Airline’s Frantic Race to Avoid a Ground-Stop Meltdown
items.summary: From its operations center in Dallas, Southwest halted bag checking and parked aircraft, then moved around planes and crews to get flights back to normal.

items.summary: The $104.44 billion fund bought $195.6 million of stock and sold nothing, lifting all 503 positions.

items.title: How Much Did The November 2026 Ground Stop Cost Airlines? The Numbers Are Staggering
items.summary: Before November 2026, it had been 25 years since U.S. flights were grounded nationwide, and it could take years for impacted airlines to financially recover.
